# Introduction

Figure S1B: Consistency of response in repeatability and reproducibility tests
for TruCulture biomarkers to distinguish between asymptomatic controls and
active TB patients. Classification formula: overall consistency =
absolute(percentage positive - 0.5) / 0.5. Donors 10001 to 10042 were
recruited from SATVI in Worcester, South Africa. Donors P1 to P4 were
recruited from Cochin Hospital in Paris, France.

# Helper functions

```{r}
#| label: helper-functions

prepare_repeatability <- function(data, cfg) {

  repeat_patients <- data %>%
    filter(VisitId == "V1", StimulusId == "Null") %>%
    group_by(PatientId, StimulusId, BatchId) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(count == 4) %>%
    pull(PatientId) %>%
    unique()

  cat(sprintf("[%s] Repeatability patients with 4 replicates: %d\n",
              cfg$name, length(repeat_patients)))

  stim_ids <- if (cfg$subtract_null) c("Null", cfg$stim) else "Null"

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(
      VisitId    == "V1",
      PatientId  %in% repeat_patients,
      StimulusId %in% stim_ids
    ) %>%
    select(PatientId, BatchId, ReplicateId, StimulusId,
           all_of(cfg$cytokine_col))

  cat(sprintf("[%s] Repeatability rows: %d\n", cfg$name, nrow(dat)))

  if (cfg$subtract_null) {

    dat <- dat %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols     = c("PatientId", "BatchId", "ReplicateId"),
        names_from  = "StimulusId",
        values_from = all_of(cfg$cytokine_col)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        !!cfg$norm_col := pmax(0, .data[[cfg$stim]] - Null),
        PositiveFlag    = as.integer(.data[[cfg$norm_col]] >= cfg$cutoff)
      )

  } else {

    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(StimulusId == "Null") %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols     = c("PatientId", "BatchId", "ReplicateId"),
        names_from  = "StimulusId",
        values_from = all_of(cfg$cytokine_col)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        !!cfg$norm_col := pmax(0, as.numeric(Null)),
        PositiveFlag    = as.integer(.data[[cfg$norm_col]] >= cfg$cutoff)
      )
  }

  cat(sprintf("[%s] Repeatability final rows: %d | Patients: %d\n",
              cfg$name, nrow(dat), n_distinct(dat$PatientId)))

  dat
}

# prepare_reproducibility

prepare_reproducibility <- function(data, cfg) {

  repro_patients <- data %>%
    filter(VisitId == "V2", StimulusId == "Null") %>%
    pull(PatientId) %>%
    unique()

  cat(sprintf("[%s] Reproducibility patients identified: %d\n",
              cfg$name, length(repro_patients)))

  stim_ids <- if (cfg$subtract_null) c("Null", cfg$stim) else "Null"

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(
      ReplicateId == "A",
      PatientId   %in% repro_patients,
      StimulusId  %in% stim_ids
    ) %>%
    select(PatientId, BatchId, VisitId, StimulusId,
           all_of(cfg$cytokine_col)) %>%
    mutate(BatchId = ifelse(BatchId == "Batch_3", "Batch_1", BatchId))

  cat(sprintf("[%s] Reproducibility rows: %d\n", cfg$name, nrow(dat)))

  if (cfg$subtract_null) {

    dat <- dat %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols     = c("PatientId", "BatchId", "VisitId"),
        names_from  = "StimulusId",
        values_from = all_of(cfg$cytokine_col)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        !!cfg$norm_col := pmax(0, .data[[cfg$stim]] - Null),
        PositiveFlag    = as.integer(.data[[cfg$norm_col]] >= cfg$cutoff)
      )

  } else {

    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(StimulusId == "Null") %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols     = c("PatientId", "BatchId", "VisitId"),
        names_from  = "StimulusId",
        values_from = all_of(cfg$cytokine_col)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        !!cfg$norm_col := pmax(0, as.numeric(Null)),
        PositiveFlag    = as.integer(.data[[cfg$norm_col]] >= cfg$cutoff)
      )
  }

  cat(sprintf("[%s] Reproducibility final rows: %d | Patients: %d\n",
              cfg$name, nrow(dat), n_distinct(dat$PatientId)))

  dat
}

# compute_consistency

compute_consistency <- function(dat, experiment_label) {
  dat %>%
    group_by(PatientId) %>%
    summarise(
      experiment           = experiment_label,
      nb_measurements      = n(),
      nb_positive          = sum(PositiveFlag),
      positive_consistency = nb_positive / nb_measurements,
      overall_consistency  = abs(positive_consistency - 0.5) / 0.5,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# make_consistency_plot

make_consistency_plot <- function(consistency_df, cfg,
                                  active_tb, patient_order,
                                  save_path = NULL) {

  plot_df <- consistency_df %>%
    mutate(
      patient_type = factor(
        ifelse(PatientId %in% active_tb, "Active TB", "Control"),
        levels = c("Control", "Active TB")
      ),
      PatientId = factor(
        PatientId,
        levels = c(
          patient_order,
          setdiff(unique(as.character(PatientId)), patient_order)
        )
      )
    )

  summary_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(experiment) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pct = mean(overall_consistency * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("Mean: %.1f%%", mean_pct))

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = PatientId, y = overall_consistency * 100, fill = patient_type)
  ) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.75) +
    geom_text(
      data        = summary_df,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      hjust       = 1.1,
      vjust       = 1.5,
      size        = 3.5,
      color       = "black",
      fontface    = "bold",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ experiment, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Control" = "#000099", "Active TB" = "red"),
      name   = "Patient type"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 105),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(cfg$name, " classification consistency"),
      x     = "Patient ID",
      y     = paste0(cfg$name, " classification consistency (%)")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                        size = 9, color = "black",
                                        face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.title         = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#34495e"),
      strip.text         = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"),
      plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position    = "top",
      legend.title       = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    tag <- gsub(" ", "_", cfg$name)
    ggsave(
      file.path(save_path, paste0("S1B_consistency_", tag, ".png")),
      plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Run all biomarker analyses

```{r}
#| label: run-all
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
#| message: true
#| warning: false

all_consistency <- list()
all_summary     <- list()

for (key in names(cytokine_config)) {

  cfg <- cytokine_config[[key]]

  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s | cutoff = %.2f pg/mL ---\n", cfg$name, cfg$cutoff))

  repeat_dat <- tryCatch(
    prepare_repeatability(df_tb_qc, cfg),
    error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Repeatability failed for %s: %s", cfg$name, e$message))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(repeat_dat) || nrow(repeat_dat) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("%s: no repeatability data, skipping.", cfg$name))
    next
  }

  repro_dat <- tryCatch(
    prepare_reproducibility(df_tb_qc, cfg),
    error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Reproducibility failed for %s: %s", cfg$name, e$message))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(repro_dat) || nrow(repro_dat) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("%s: no reproducibility data, skipping.", cfg$name))
    next
  }

  repeat_cons <- compute_consistency(repeat_dat, "Repeatability")
  repro_cons  <- compute_consistency(repro_dat,  "Reproducibility")

  repro_cons_filtered <- repro_cons %>%
    filter(!PatientId %in% active_tb_patients)

  cat(sprintf(
    "Reproducibility: %d patients before filtering, %d after removing active TB\n",
    nrow(repro_cons), nrow(repro_cons_filtered)
  ))

  consistency_df <- bind_rows(repro_cons_filtered, repeat_cons) %>%
    mutate(biomarker = cfg$name)

  all_consistency[[key]] <- consistency_df

  summary_df <- consistency_df %>%
    group_by(experiment) %>%
    summarise(
      biomarker          = cfg$name,
      cutoff_pgmL        = cfg$cutoff,
      n                  = n(),
      n_control          = sum(!PatientId %in% active_tb_patients),
      n_active_tb        = sum(PatientId  %in% active_tb_patients),
      mean_consistency   = mean(overall_consistency   * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_consistency = median(overall_consistency * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_consistency     = sd(overall_consistency     * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  all_summary[[key]] <- summary_df

  cat("Consistency summary:\n")
  print(summary_df)

  make_consistency_plot(
    consistency_df = consistency_df,
    cfg            = cfg,
    active_tb      = active_tb_patients,
    patient_order  = patient_order,
    save_path      = output_cons
  )
}
```

# Save all results

```{r}
#| label: save-results

all_consistency_df <- bind_rows(all_consistency)

all_summary_df <- bind_rows(all_summary) %>%
  arrange(biomarker, experiment)

cat("Combined summary across all biomarkers:\n")
print(all_summary_df, n = Inf)

patient_type_summary <- all_consistency_df %>%
  mutate(
    patient_type = ifelse(
      PatientId %in% active_tb_patients, "Active TB", "Control"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, experiment, patient_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n                  = n(),
    mean_consistency   = mean(overall_consistency   * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_consistency = median(overall_consistency * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_consistency     = sd(overall_consistency     * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Consistency_all"      = all_consistency_df,
    "Summary_by_biomarker" = all_summary_df,
    "Summary_by_type"      = patient_type_summary
  ),
  path = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S1B_consistency_results.xlsx")
)

cat("All outputs saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```
